text:
Alex Chen: Ok kicking off the catalog GTM ops thread — objective: coordinate marketplace listings (AWS/GCP/Azure), partner press, joint landing page, and SI integration demo timeline. Quick sync to align owners and deadlines.
Priya Nair: thanks alex. do we have an embargo / announce window target?
Alex Chen: aiming for a mid-May public launch. tentative announce embargo -> May 14 08:00 PT. need to confirm with partners and legal.
Jorge Ramirez: mid-May works for our APAC customers too? raises timezone/marketplace cert timing. AWS listing cert can take up to 7 business days. suggest we start AWS submission by Apr 28.
Mei Wong: landing page assets list (from product): 1) hero copy + 1-liner 2) 3 feature bullets (dedicated, private, hosted) 3) partner logos + short blurbs 4) product screenshots 5) joint CTA form / demo request. who owns copy & design?
Priya Nair: marketing will own copy + design. Mei can share screenshots. Samir can help with partner blurbs for SI. milestone: draft assets by Apr 20.
Samir Patel: SI partners need an integration one-pager. I'll consolidate tech bullets and a short customer flow. Also we should prepare a 10–12 min joint demo script for partner webinars.
Jorge Ramirez: on marketplaces: GCP and Azure have separate submission flows. we should parallelize. I can start Azure tomorrow. who will own GCP?
Mei Wong: I'll take GCP listing. I have the model performance screenshots and latency/cost table.
Alex Chen: owners: AWS -> Jorge, Azure -> Jorge, GCP -> Mei. Marketing -> Priya for page + press. SI + partner blurbs -> Samir. Legal review -> @marketing-bot will flag next steps.
marketing-bot: Reminder: submit Partner Announcement short-form to Legal (legal@redwood) by Apr 22 for embargo review.
Priya Nair: press plan: embargoed press release + 2 blog posts (product + partner case study) + joint social assets. Draft PR copy by Apr 24; partner review window 48 hours.
Samir Patel: for hardware partner (NVIDIA) we need to coordinate a joint bench result graphic and an optional quote. I'll reach out to their comms lead and propose the May 14 date.
Jorge Ramirez: dependencies: marketplace certs, partner logo approvals, legal embargo signoff, SI customer reference. we should map risk on each.
Mei Wong: small checklist snippet: ```
- Screenshots (3x) -> Mei 
- Feature copy -> Priya
- Partner logos (eps) -> partners/legal
- Marketplace artifacts (privacy, security docs) -> Eng Sec
- Demo video (10m) -> Samir
- Landing page QA -> Product
```
Priya Nair: can we get a shared deadline board? i'll make a short Asana board and invite owners today.
Alex Chen: great. action items: 1) Jorge start AWS/Azure submissions by Apr 28 2) Mei submit GCP by Apr 28 3) Priya draft PR & page copy by Apr 24 4) Samir collect SI + NVIDIA assets by Apr 20 5) Legal review by Apr 22.
Jorge Ramirez: noted. i'll ping aws marketplace team for expedited review if needed.
Samir Patel: quick Q — do we want a gated demo sign-up (sales follow-up) or direct trial link on landing page?
Priya Nair: gated demo for partner-case conversions, direct trial link for self-serve product users. add both CTAs.
Mei Wong: rolling to-do: screenshots and latency table uploaded to /shared/marketing/assets/marketplace on Apr 12.
Alex Chen: tagging follow-ups: @Priya Nair please confirm post copy tone (partner-first vs product-first) by Apr 18. @Jorge Ramirez confirm marketplace timelines Apr 21. @Samir Patel confirm partner quotes by Apr 20.
marketing-bot: Calendar event suggestion: "Marketplace GTM ops weekly" starting Apr 7, Tuesdays 9am PT — invite sent.
Priya Nair: i'll set up a partner review slot for May 12 (dry-run).
Jorge Ramirez: any objections to joint webinar the week after launch (May 20–24)? good for pipeline.
Alex Chen: sounds good. set tentative webinar date May 21. finalize after partner confirmation.
Samir Patel: will draft the integration one-pager and demo script this week, share for feedback by Apr 15.
Mei Wong: thanks all — will upload screenshots and start GCP forms today.
Alex Chen: perfect. thanks team :thumbsup:
